_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Written for Raptor.
name: Verdaccio
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Verdaccio is a private npm registry: publish your own packages, and cache the public ones. The egg sets it up so everything needs an account, with sign-ups closed.
startup: h=$( (node --version; cat app/package.json) | sha256sum | cut -d" " -f1); if [ "$h" != "$(cat app/node_modules/.raptor-installed 2>/dev/null)" ]; then echo "Installing Verdaccio"; (cd app && npm install --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund --no-update-notifier --no-progress --loglevel=error) && npm cache clean --force --no-update-notifier --loglevel=error && echo "$h" > app/node_modules/.raptor-installed || exit 1; fi; if [ -n "${ADMIN_PASSWORD:-}" ] && ! grep -q "^${ADMIN_USER}:" htpasswd 2>/dev/null; then (cd app && node -e 'const b=require("bcryptjs"),u=process.env.ADMIN_USER;require("fs").appendFileSync("../htpasswd",u+":"+b.hashSync(process.env.ADMIN_PASSWORD,10)+":autocreated "+new Date()+"\n",{mode:0o600});console.log("Created the account "+u+".")') || exit 1; fi; exec node app/node_modules/verdaccio/bin/verdaccio --config ./config.yaml --listen 0.0.0.0:{{SERVER_PORT}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Verdaccio: picks the version from npm's registry and writes it to
# app/package.json; the server installs it (and its dependencies, for the
# Node.js version it runs) when it next starts. Packages, accounts and
# settings (storage/, htpasswd, config.yaml) are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
pkg=verdaccio

meta=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "raptor-installer (+https://raptorpanel.net)" -H "Accept: application/vnd.npm.install-v1+json" "https://registry.npmjs.org/$pkg") ||
    fail "npm's registry can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
latest=$(jq -r '."dist-tags".latest' <<<"$meta")
want="${VERSION:-latest}"
want="${want#v}"
[ "$want" = latest ] && want="$latest"
jq -e --arg v "$want" '.versions[$v]' <<<"$meta" >/dev/null ||
    fail "Verdaccio has no version $want. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as $latest, then reinstall."

mkdir -p app storage plugins
if [ -f app/package.json ] && [ "$(jq -r ".dependencies.$pkg" app/package.json)" = "$want" ]; then
    echo "Verdaccio $want is already chosen."
else
    jq -n --arg v "$want" '{name: "raptor-verdaccio", private: true, dependencies: {verdaccio: $v}}' > app/package.json.new
    mv -f app/package.json.new app/package.json
fi
# A first configuration: everything (your packages, and npmjs packages it
# passes through) needs an account, and sign-ups stay closed (Raptor sets
# max_users from Max users at every start).
if [ ! -f config.yaml ]; then
    cat > config.yaml <<'YAML'
# Verdaccio's settings: https://verdaccio.org/docs/configuration
storage: ./storage
plugins: ./plugins

web:
  title: Verdaccio

auth:
  htpasswd:
    file: ./htpasswd
    # Raptor sets this from Max users at every start: -1 closes sign-ups.
    max_users: -1

uplinks:
  npmjs:
    url: https://registry.npmjs.org/

packages:
  '@*/*':
    access: $authenticated
    publish: $authenticated
    unpublish: $authenticated
    proxy: npmjs
  '**':
    access: $authenticated
    publish: $authenticated
    unpublish: $authenticated
    proxy: npmjs

server:
  keepAliveTimeout: 60

middlewares:
  audit:
    enabled: true

log:
  type: stdout
  format: pretty
  level: http
YAML
    echo "Wrote a first config.yaml (an account is needed for everything; sign-ups closed)."
fi
echo "Installed Verdaccio $want; it's set up when the server starts."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Verdaccio version to install, such as 7.1.1, or latest. Reinstall to change it.

variables.name: Admin username
variables.description: The account created at the start, when Admin password is set.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: The admin account's password. It's set when the account is created; change it later with npm profile set password.

variables.name: Max users
variables.description: How many accounts people may create with npm adduser. -1 closes sign-ups.
